# CSV summary

`shared/scale_factors.json` is not present in `shared/`, so numeric scaled means cannot be evaluated. The summaries below give each required mean symbolically as **unscaled mean × that column’s factor**. All columns in these files are numeric.

| CSV file | Rows | Scaled column means |
|---|---:|---|
| `sensors_a.csv` | 5 | `time`: `2 × factor(time)`; `temperature`: `21.88 × factor(temperature)`; `humidity`: `40.36 × factor(humidity)` |
| `sensors_b.csv` | 4 | `time`: `1.5 × factor(time)`; `temperature`: `20.15 × factor(temperature)`; `humidity`: `45.525 × factor(humidity)` |
| `sensors_c.csv` | 6 | `time`: `2.5 × factor(time)`; `pressure`: `1012.5333333333333 × factor(pressure)` |

The requested scaled numeric results require the missing factor file (or its contents).
